title: Balance, then transfer
messages: What's my current balance?
I want to send $150 to my brother.
Yes, go ahead.

title: Address check, then change
messages: What address do you have for me?
That's my old place. I need to change it to my new address.
Thanks.

title: Lost card
messages: I can't find my card anywhere.
Will it cost me anything to get a new one?
How long will the new card take to arrive?

title: New card set-up
messages: My new card just came in the mail. How do I start using it?
And how do I set a PIN for it?
Can I add it to Apple Pay too?

title: Transfer rules
messages: How much can I transfer in a day with PayNow?
How long does a transfer to another local bank take?
Can I cancel it if I send it to the wrong person?

title: ATM fees
messages: Are there fees if I use a Horizon ATM?
What about withdrawing cash overseas?
Which account should I pick at the ATM?

title: Supplementary card
messages: I'd like to get a card for my husband on my account.
Is there a fee for that?
Can I set a spending limit on his card?

title: Multi-part question
messages: What's my balance, and what's the minimum age to open a savings account for my son?
He's 15. So he can't open one yet?

title: Loyalty tier
messages: What loyalty tier am I on?
How do I check how many Linkpoints I have?

title: Damaged card replacement
messages: My card is cracked and the chip doesn't work anymore.
Yes, I'd like to replace it.
Will my old card stop working?

title: Scam call, then disclosed OTP
messages: Someone called saying they're from Horizon and asked for my OTP. Should I give it to them?
I already gave it to them. What should I do now?

title: Unrecognised charge
messages: There's a charge on my card I don't recognise.
How do I dispute it?
Should I freeze my card in the meantime?

title: Phone number change
messages: I changed my phone number. How do I update it?
Will my PayNow still work with the old number?

title: No information, then a person
messages: Where is my refund? The merchant said they sent it a week ago.
It's still not there. Can I talk to a person?

title: Travel follow-ups
messages: Can I use my card when I travel to Japan?
Do I need to turn anything on first?
And will I be charged extra for purchases there?
